summary: Ansible Vault keeps passwords and keys encrypted so files can go into source control; an example shows ansible_ssh_pass as a !vault value alongside connection settings.
questions: How do I store network device SSH passwords securely?
Can vault-encrypted files go in git?

answer_card.title: Vault for network passwords
answer_card.answer_md:
Vault-encrypted values can safely live in playbooks, roles or source control:
```yaml
ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli
ansible_network_os: vyos.vyos.vyos
ansible_user: my_vyos_user
ansible_ssh_pass: !vault |
  $ANSIBLE_VAULT;1.1;AES256
  3933623163...
```
